about.title: Moreno Valley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Nine people died on Moreno Valley roads in 2025, according to the most recent final crash records for the city. Each of those numbers was someone's spouse, parent, or child, and the families left behind now face questions no one prepares for. A wrongful death claim in California is a civil matter, entirely separate from any criminal case tied to the crash on SR-60, Perris Boulevard, Heacock Street, or Alessandro Boulevard. It exists so that surviving family members can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Standing is limited: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Riverside County families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Moreno Valley Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you are connected with can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines that do not wait for grief
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Early contact protects that timeline.

items.title: A civil path separate from any criminal case
items.desc: Whether or not prosecutors pursue charges, your family's civil claim for funeral costs, lost support, and lost companionship stands on its own. The attorney handles it on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My spouse was killed on SR-60 in Moreno Valley. Does it matter that a state highway was involved?
items.answer: It can. If a public agency such as Caltrans or the City of Moreno Valley bears any responsibility, for example through road design or maintenance, California requires a government claim to be filed on a much shorter timeline than the usual two years. That is one reason families often reach out soon after a highway death rather than waiting for the investigation to close.

items.question: The driver who caused the crash is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves independently of any criminal proceeding. The two cases have different goals, and a conviction is not required for your family to pursue recovery of funeral expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of love and guidance.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and we simply match you with an independent attorney who reviews wrongful death matters in Riverside County. Those attorneys work on contingency, which means no fee unless there is a recovery for your family.
